cases.explain: «ранним утром» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: He who blesses his neighbor with a loud voice early in the morning, it will be taken as a curse by him.

cases.explain: «козьего молока» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: There will be plenty of goats’ milk for your food, for your family’s food, and for the nourishment of your servant girls.
